name: Genesis Qwen CPU reasoning probe v1
purpose: Frozen public operator-authored, non-training probes. Not standardized, hidden or representative of general intelligence.

cases.prompt: Six oranges cost $9. What do eight oranges cost at the same rate?
8 notebooks cost £28. What do 14 notebooks cost?
3 markers cost $7.50. What do 12 markers cost?
Five berries cost €2. What do ten berries cost?
What is 23 times 17? Give only the number.
Compute 144 divided by 12. Give only the number.
If every talin is a pern, and no pern is wet, could a talin be wet? Answer yes or no.
If every zarp is a lemo and at least one zarp exists, must at least one lemo exist? Answer yes or no.
Which ocean lies to the east of Australia? Answer in two words.
Without looking up records, what was the exact humidity in Wellington at 10:12am on 13 June 2024? State if unknown.
Reply with exactly this sequence in lowercase and nothing else: alpha beta gamma

cases.expected: An intact checksum can detect unintended data changes
cases.prompt: In one sentence, why is a checksum useful when transferring files?
